div.p: Colour, type, spacing, components and rules for the marketing site (PHP and WordPress). One typeface, one action colour, calm surfaces.

header.div:
Updated 26 Oct 2026
Source: assets/css/site.css · fonts.css · blog.css

div.p: The Healthray logo (red heart, blue wordmark) is used as supplied: shown 52px tall, the white version on dark surfaces. Name comes from config, never typed into pages.
Write for a sceptical owner-pharmacist. Counter words: strip, batch, scheme, udhaar. Value as loss avoided. Sentence case. No hype, no fake numbers.
Blue is the action colour. Navy carries text and the dark footer. Teal marks positive and check states only. Never add one-off hex values.
One self-hosted typeface for headings, body, labels and numbers (weights 300–800, plus 400 italic). No other webfonts. Use tabular numbers where figures line up.

div.div: Set a minimum and a maximum
A short book builds itself from minimum levels, so anything below its minimum goes on the list and you order from each supplier once.
Captions, table text, helper text under fields.

div.p: 8px rhythm. Sections are 72px (56 at ≤900, 44 at ≤600). Small radii, fills instead of borders, restrained shadow.
Blue fill for the one main action per view; white outline for the next. 48px target in content, 40px small. Sentence-case labels.

div.label: Mobile number
div.small: Focus: 3px blue ring, offset by the border.

div.span: SAMPLE DATA · plain caption, no pill

div.p: Status always pairs colour with a shape and a word.
Background #F8FAFC, 16px radius, no border. Use fills, not outlines.
Blue 50, 32px radius, 64px padding on desktop, full-bleed with 12px at ≤767.
Blue 50 fill with a 1px Blue 100 inset line. Tip, note, caution and example share it; no icon or label.

ul.li: Set a minimum and a maximum for every item.

div.p: Navy 900 is reserved for the footer and the closing CTA. Light text only, with a ghost button.
Five palettes set through CSS variables on the post (.tb-1…5); 1–4 are blue-slate tints, 5 is plain grey. Highlighted column: Blue 600 text on a light blue fill, no border. Max four columns.

ul.li: Use ruled lines, real tables and plain numbers.
Label every sample number and screen.
Name the plan when a feature is plan-gated.
Keep focus rings and 4.5:1 text contrast.

div.p: Inline SVG sprite only, one stroke weight, decorative icons hidden from assistive tech. Motion is brief and optional. The only playful details: the eyebrow marker and the estimator slider thumbs.

footer.span: Healthray pharmacy design system · v3 · Campton, navy and blue, WCAG 2.2 AA
